purpose: Stabilize Sheikha before further development by governing repository duplication, Jest discovery, CommonJS and ESM compatibility, API response contracts, VS Code extension compatibility, and CI readiness.

controls.name: repository_duplication_guard
controls.rule: Jest must ignore generated, archived, vendored, Docker production, duplicated repository, and virtual environment paths.

controls.name: esm_commonjs_guard
controls.rule: Runtime models should avoid fragile CommonJS imports of ESM-only dependencies when Node core provides a stable equivalent.

controls.name: api_contract_registry
controls.rule: Extension-facing APIs must return a canonical envelope containing success, data, and timestamp while allowing documented legacy mirrors.

controls.name: test_governance
controls.rule: CI failures must be converted into a lesson, contract update, and verification command before merge.

controls.name: extension_compatibility
controls.rule: VS Code extension endpoints remain governed by explicit contracts before extension tests are made mandatory in CI.
